text:
Jess M: Pinging @Miguel R and @sec-bot for a quick security sanity check on PR #4321 — on-prem auth changes + KMS flow. Planning to merge tomorrow 10:00 PT unless any blockers.

Miguel R: Looking now. High level question — does this introduce new VPC egress rules or expose any SA tokens?

Alex C: The PR is two parts: a small kube manifest tweak and switching the auth service to use a customer-managed KMS key. Snippet:```diff
- env:
-   KMS_KEY: ""
+ env:
+   KMS_KEY: "projects/prod/kms/keys/redwood-onprem"
  VPC_EGRESS: "restricted"
```

Samira P: We should confirm HSM path and rotation impact. If that key is hard-coded we need a short doc update and a rota plan. Also CI is flaky on the auth e2e right now.

sec-bot: automated scan: no plaintext secrets found. Detected KMS usage pattern; recommend enabling audit logging and restricting key IAM to a dedicated service account.

Miguel R: Quick checklist for me: limit KMS IAM to `sa-onprem-kms`, avoid literal keys in repo if possible (env lookup > hardcode), restrict VPC egress CIDR to whitelisted ranges, and run a k8s-sa RBAC dry-run. If you can switch to lookup, I can LGT M faster.

Jess M: Got it — switching to env lookup now. The CI fail is from the local HSM emulator; repro steps below.

Alex C: For merge timing: SRE wants a 4-hour lead before on-prem deploys. If you make the change (lookup + audit flag) and CI is green, are we ok to merge in that window?

Samira P: Don't merge before the 08:00 PT deployment window. Also tagging @Miguel R for explicit sec sign-off once the literal is removed.

Miguel R: I'll give LGTM once the key literal is gone and CI passes. Quick repro command: `scripts/hsm-emulator start && yarn test:e2e --filter auth`

Jess M: I'll update the PR in ~1h. Can someone keep an eye on reviews? I also requested a hold on merges. @deploy-bot please hold merges for this repo until 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: hold placed by Jess M on repo redwood/onprem-auth until 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z (reason: awaiting sec + CI green).

Samira P: Thanks — Alex, can you review the k8s SA scope change when you have a sec?

Alex C: On it, will review in ~30m.

Jess M: Thanks team — I'll post back here when PR is updated and CI passes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
